explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: approximately 30 named tracks/releases across current Hardspace/Space Textures material, adjacent SK_eleven and overlooked Ilian Tape catalogue
exclusions: future September 11 SK_eleven material retained as watch only
peak-time framing was not automatically excluded but was penalized when it supplied no useful long-form purpose
same-label or close-BPM relations were not treated as proof of flow
no parked STRANGE GAIT revisit was recycled without a trigger
rankedLeadSummary: 1. UMFANG — Complete Your Collection (Hardspace Mix): current Sep 4; 135 BPM; Hardspace specifically describes layered rhythmic complexity, shifting bass weight and a trippy floor-focused drive
2. Phil Berg — Chimera: 138 BPM; SK_eleven's Iso release is framed as reduction/discipline with rhythmic loops that breathe and shift
3. John Darque — Contour: current Sep 4 Space Textures release; release framing centers meditations on rhythm, drift and spaces between certainty and dream
4. Snuff Crew — Where's The Bad? (Hardspace Mix): current Sep 4; 135 BPM; track-specific description says it is stripped to a singular hypnotic loop for peak-time impact
